The Porsche 718 family

2 generations and variants in the Index, 1957–2025. Oldest first; every card opens the full page, with its own versions, figures and story.

  1. 1957–1961

    Porsche 718 (RSK, RS 60 and RS 61)

    The little silver Spyder that took Porsche from class wins to overall wins: third at Le Mans in 1958, winner of the Targa Florio in 1959 and 1960, and first and second at Sebring in 1960.

    160 hp5.2 sec 0-60162 mph top
  2. 2024–2025

    Porsche 718 Spyder RS

    The most powerful Boxster Porsche built: the Cayman GT4 RS's 9,000-rpm flat-6 in an open car, 30 years after the Boxster concept.

    493 hp2.8 sec 0-60191 mph top
